title: RadarPillars: Efficient Object Detection from 4D Radar Point Clouds (ITSC 2024)
text: VoD 4D radar: compensated radial velocity split into cos(azimuth) v_r and sin(azimuth) v_r (+3.8 mAP over PointPillars 39.5, the largest single step), PointNet pillars, PillarAttention (self-attention over occupied pillars only; core IS attention; +1.1 to +3.4 mAP in the ablation), 3-stage CNN of constant width 32. 1 frame entire-area mAP 46.0 vs 39.5; 5 frames 50.7. 0.27 M parameters, 1.99 GFLOPs, 86.6 Hz V100, 184.5 Hz RTX 3090. Text and Table III disagree on the attention gain; no code.
idea: ray direction inside the Doppler feature; narrow constant width

title: SMURF: Spatial Multi-Representation Fusion for 3D Object Detection with 4D Imaging Radar (T-IV 2024)
text: No attention. PointPillars branch plus two kernel-density branches whose kernel is a product over x, y, z and Doppler (bandwidths 1.5 / 2 m VoD), sparse 3D convs, concatenation, FPN neck. VoD val 5 scans mAP3D 50.97 (corridor 69.72); TJ4DRadSet test 32.99; KDE worth +2.93 / +3.02 mAP3D; 0.033 s per scan VoD (GPU not named). Hand-designed density feature that includes the Doppler axis; printed kernel has a sign typo; no code.
idea: density of neighbours in space and Doppler as a point feature

title: RadarGNN: Transformation Invariant Graph Neural Network for Radar-based Perception (CVPRW 2023)
text: kNN graph (k = 20) over 500 ms of RadarScenes points, edge features from relative position (translation invariant) or point-pair distance and velocity angles (rotation invariant), max-aggregation MPNN, no attention. mAP at IoU 0.3: no invariance 19.4, translation 56.5, translation + rotation 19.6; segmentation F1 68.1 / 77.1 / 76.5; beats PointNet++ F1 74.3. No latency. Code GPL-3.0.
idea: relative offsets yes; rotation invariance of the sensor frame no

title: RadarNeXt: Real-Time and Reliable 3D Object Detector Based On 4D mmWave Imaging Radar
text: No attention. Pillars (64 channels, 0.16 m), MobileOne re-parameterised depthwise backbone, one DCNv3 deformable conv level, PAN + FPN, CenterHead. VoD val 5 scans mAP 50.48 with 1.58 M parameters (dense 4.7 M backbone 48.9); TJ4DRadSet 32.30; 67.1 FPS on an RTX A4000, 28.4 FPS Jetson AGX Orin. DCNv3 placement swings mAP 46.96 to 50.48. Apache-2.0 repo.
idea: deformable conv follows position error; small conv-only radar BEV net

title: RadarDistill: Boosting Radar-based Object Detection Performance via Knowledge Distillation from LiDAR Features (CVPR 2024)
text: nuScenes radar-only test: 20.5 mAP / 43.7 NDS vs PillarNet 8.6 / 34.7, KPConvPillars 4.9 / 13.9, Radar-PointGNN 0.5 / 3.4. Pillars + sparse 2D convs + CenterHead; CMA densifies the radar BEV with deformable and ConvNeXt blocks (+2.0 NDS), lidar feature distillation (AFD +4.4 NDS, PFD +1.0) in training only. No attention; no latency; radar attributes not listed on the pages read.
idea: radar BEV densification; point nets rank far below pillar CNNs on nuScenes

title: Improved Multi-Scale Grid Rendering of Point Clouds for Radar Object Detection Networks (KPBEV / KPPillarsBEV, FUSION 2023)
text: No attention. nuScenes radar (x, y, compensated v_r, RCS, dt; 5 sweeps): offsets and point count per point, KPConv evaluated at non-empty cell centres, written to a 0.5 m x 64 channel map, rendered at 4 scales into a ResNet. Car AP4.0 PointPillars 38.31, KPBEV 41.21 at the same speed (87 FPS V100), multi-scale KPPillarsBEV 43.68 at 60 FPS. No code, no feature ablation.
idea: per-point state in a KPConv then rendered at cell centres with offset inputs

title: Improved Orientation Estimation and Detection with Hybrid Object Detection Networks for Automotive Radar
text: Abstract only: a point-based network (GNN or KPConv) before grid rendering and a conv backbone; nuScenes car mAP +19.7 % over the next radar-only submission, orientation +11.5 % relative. The submitted KPConvPillars is 4.9 mAP / 13.9 NDS on the 10-class test set (RadarDistill table). Predecessor of KPBEV; PDF not readable.

title: DoppDrive: Doppler-Driven Temporal Aggregation for Improved Radar Object Detection (ICCV 2025)
text: Old sweep points are shifted radially by the dynamic Doppler times dt after ego-motion, and each point gets its own aggregation window (T0 - Tk <= D / (|v| g(theta)), D = 2 m) from the tangential smear that grows with the angle. SMURF on aiMotive vehicle AP 74.6 none / 81.7 standard / 89.1 DoppDrive; LRR-Sim 89.2 / 91.1 / 93.3. 2.0 ms on a V100. No nuScenes or VoD; no code licence.
idea: radial shift by v dt and angle-dependent window

title: SMIFormer: Learning Spatial Feature Representation for 3D Object Detection from 4D Imaging Radar via Multi-View Interactive Transformers (Sensors 2023)
text: ATTENTION core. Voxels projected to BEV, front and side planes, window attention within and across views. VoD val mAP entire area / corridor 48.77 / 71.13 vs VoxelNet base 46.48 / 68.36 (self-attention +0.16 / +1.35, cross-view +1.18 / +1.13); 61 ms with window 4, GPU not named. Baselines retrained by the authors (PointPillars 45.4 here vs 39.5 in RadarPillars). No code.

title: SpaRC: Sparse Radar-Camera Fusion for 3D Object Detection
text: ATTENTION core. Light Point Transformer over raw radar points (4 stages 32-256 channels, patch 64, space-filling-curve order), range-adaptive radar aggregation (+4.1 NDS / +5.9 mAP over the camera baseline with local attention), no BEV grid. nuScenes val R50 62.0 NDS / 54.5 mAP; test 67.1 NDS / 60.0 mAP; whole detector 32.9 FPS (R18) to 7.2 FPS (R101) on an RTX 3090 FP16, radar share not reported. Code announced, not released.

title: IRGNN: Efficient Invariant Radar Graph Neural Network for Radar Point Cloud Object Detection
text: Abstract only: RadarGNN-style translation and rotation invariant graph with residual message passing and a virtual node, RadarScenes; no numbers, GPU or code on the page.

title: MVFAN: Multi-View Feature Assisted Network for 4D Radar Object Detection
text: Digest from a search summary: anchor-free single stage, position map generation reweighting foreground and background points, a radar-feature-assisted backbone that uses Doppler and RCS, parallel cylindrical-projection and pillar branches; Astyx and VoD. RadarPillars lists it at 39.4 mAP (VoD entire area, 1 frame). The PDF is too large for the fetch tool; not read.

title: RPFA-Net: a 4D Radar Pillar Feature Attention Network for 3D Object Detection (ITSC 2021)
text: Digest from the abstract record: PointNet in the pillar encoder replaced by self-attention over the points of a pillar (ATTENTION core); Astyx HiRes 2019 only, +8.13 % 3D mAP and +5.52 % BEV mAP over its PointPillars baseline; code at adept-thu/RPFA-Net (not opened). The pillar-level attention idea reappears in RadarPillars.

title: Radar-PointGNN: Graph Based Object Recognition for Unstructured Radar Point-cloud Data (IEEE Radar Conference 2021)
text: Digest: kNN graph over radar points, convolution along edges; the first radar object recognition model on nuScenes. On the nuScenes test leaderboard it scores 0.5 mAP / 3.4 NDS (RadarDistill table, checked) - a graph point network without a grid stays far below pillar CNNs there. No arXiv id; TU Delft repository copy not read.
